# AeroStrat

> AeroStrat (Intelligence Driven Aviation) is building the next generation of aviation technology: one connected ecosystem for airline operations, spanning training, safety and compliance, flight operations, maintenance and engineering, and network planning, on a single shared foundation set up to each airline's own manuals and authority. Its team pairs 25 years of experience in the aviation sector with deep technology expertise. AeroStrat started with pilot training, where two products are live with airlines today: AeroStrat EBT/CBTA for evidence-based competency assessment and grading, and AeroStrat TMS for training planning, validity tracking and records. Based in Tallinn, Estonia.

Website: https://aero-strat.com
Contact: info@aero-strat.com
Location: Tallinn, Estonia
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/aero-strat/

## Vision and ecosystem

- **Vision:** To establish the definitive digital operating system for global airlines, unifying fragmented data into a single source of operational intelligence and continuous oversight.
- **Mission:** To engineer intuitive, enterprise-grade technology that eliminates operational silos, transforming complex data into connected intelligence so airlines can optimize performance, elevate safety and drive continuous improvement across their entire ecosystem.

AeroStrat is building one connected technology ecosystem for airline operations on a single shared foundation: one crew list, one record and one login across every module. Training is live; the next domains follow on the same foundation.

1. **Training (live):** AeroStrat EBT/CBTA for competency assessment and AeroStrat TMS for training management, on one pilot record.
2. **Safety & Compliance (next):** occurrence reporting and audit findings tied back to the competency evidence behind them.
3. **Flight Operations (next):** crew qualification, currency and rostering constraints in the same record as training.
4. **Maintenance & Engineering (next):** technical training and authorisation tracking on the shared competency framework.
5. **Network Planning (next):** capacity and crew readiness modelled against the training pipeline.

## Products

- [AeroStrat EBT/CBTA](https://aero-strat.com/ebt-cbta.md): Evidence-Based Training (EBT) and Competency-Based Training and Assessment (CBTA) platform for airline recurrent pilot training. Every check is graded against the ICAO nine-competency framework on the airline's own forms and scoring rules, following the ICAO, IATA and EASA method (also ECAA). Produces a signed PDF per evaluation, a permanent per-pilot history with a full edit audit trail, and analytics at three levels: pilot, cohort and fleet. For Training Directors, Heads of Training and TRE/TRI leads.
- [AeroStrat TMS](https://aero-strat.com/tms.md): Training management system for airlines. Pilot validity (licences, medicals, checks and courses), planning, recurrent training, records and audit in one system, configured to the airline's Operations Manual (OM-D) and authority. Gives a daily action list of renewals by status (green, yellow, red, expired, missing). For Directors of Training, Heads of Training and Crew Training Managers.
- [How they work together](https://aero-strat.com/solutions.md): Airlines that take both products share one crew list, one pilot record and one login, so nothing is typed twice.

## Key facts

- Not tied to one regulator: each airline is configured to its own training manual and authority.
- Every airline's data is isolated from every other's; pilot and cabin-crew records are kept separate at the database level, and data is exportable in full at any time.
- Role-based access in both products, with every action logged.
- The instructor always sets the final grade; any override needs a written reason, and AeroStrat never overwrites it. The airline keeps every regulatory obligation.
- AeroStrat EBT/CBTA sits alongside an airline's LMS; it does not deliver e-learning.
- Implementation: four stages, about five weeks from receiving the airline's manual, records and forms. The airline names one owner; AeroStrat does the setup.
- Founding reference client: AlMasria Universal Airlines, with 120+ pilots and 250+ cabin crew and more than 14,000 grades recorded to date.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is AeroStrat?** A next-generation aviation technology company in Tallinn, Estonia, building one connected software ecosystem for airline operations. Its training products, AeroStrat EBT/CBTA and AeroStrat TMS, are live with airlines today.

**What does AeroStrat EBT/CBTA do?** It grades every pilot check against the ICAO nine-competency framework on the airline's own forms and scoring rules, following the ICAO, IATA and EASA method, with a signed PDF per evaluation and analytics for the pilot, the cohort and the fleet.

**What does AeroStrat TMS do?** It manages pilot validity (licences, medicals, checks and courses), planning, recurrent training, records and audit in one system, configured to the airline's Operations Manual (OM-D) and authority.

**Which regulators does it support?** It is not tied to one regulator: each airline is configured to its own training manual and authority, including EASA and ECAA frameworks.

**How long does implementation take?** Four stages, about five weeks from receiving the airline's manual, records and forms. The airline names one owner; AeroStrat does the setup.

**Is it a learning management system (LMS)?** No. Neither product delivers e-learning; they record, plan and analyse training and assessment, alongside the airline's LMS.

**Who decides the final grade?** The instructor always sets the final grade. Any override needs a written reason, and AeroStrat never overwrites it.

**How is airline data protected?** Every airline's data is isolated from every other's, pilot and cabin-crew records are kept separate at the database level, access is role-based with every action logged, and data is exportable in full at any time.

**Who uses AeroStrat today?** Founding reference client AlMasria Universal Airlines, with 120+ pilots and 250+ cabin crew and more than 14,000 grades recorded to date.

**How do I see it?** Book a walkthrough on your own check forms and crew data at https://aero-strat.com/contact or email info@aero-strat.com.
